senses.gloss: , m.(b. h.; לגג onomatop. to lick, lap; to gurgle v. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v. לגג) a small narrow-necked vessel, Log, a liquid measure equal to the contents of (or the space occupied by) six eggs (v. Herzfeld Metrol. p. 46, sq.).
